## `client.ci_trust_rules`

The CI trust rules resource of the platform API; instance administrators only.

### `client.ci_trust_rules.create`

Signature: `client.ci_trust_rules.create(*, issuer: str, principal: str, environment: str, repository: str, conditions: Mapping[str, str], kinds: Sequence[str] = ('deploy',), start_on_deploy_jobs: bool = False, override_reason: str | None = None) -> CiTrustRule`

Create an enabled CI trust rule.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer` | `str` | required | ``github``, ``gitlab`` or a configured issuer URL. |
| `principal` | `str` | required | The active service account the CI job acts as; it needs its own `DEPLOY` grant. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment it may deploy to. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | The registered repository it may deploy. |
| `conditions` | `Mapping[str, str]` | required | Claim name to exact text; must pin ``repository_id`` (GitHub) or ``project_id`` (GitLab), and ``ref`` or ``environment``. |
| `kinds` | `Sequence[str]` | `('deploy',)` | ``deploy`` and/or ``dry_run``. |
| `start_on_deploy_jobs` | `bool` | `False` | Let a deploy under the rule start the project's `on_deploy` jobs; sent only when true, so a server that predates the setting accepts the request. |
| `override_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line, to create the rule although an access file manages its scope (an audited override, for an administrator of the instance). |

Returns: `CiTrustRule`. The rule.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If a field breaks the rules (the message says which). |

### `client.ci_trust_rules.explain`

Signature: `client.ci_trust_rules.explain(claims: Mapping[str, Any], *, environment: str, repository: str, issuer: str | None = None) -> CiTrustExplanation`

Say which rule an exchange with these ID token claims would match, and why not others.

Needs no ID token: paste the claims a CI job printed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claims` | `Mapping[str, Any]` | required | The ID token's claims, decoded. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment the exchange would ask for. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | The repository it would ask for. |
| `issuer` | `str | None` | `None` | The issuer; the ``iss`` claim when `None`. |

Returns: `CiTrustExplanation`. The verdict and every rule's reasons.
